run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained fully blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) — reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au — even though the proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, no recent relay failures), i.e. an organisation-level egress policy rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; every opportunity is captured at headline level, and detail fields are drawn only from WebSearch result link titles (which carry the target page's own <title>, e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable for existence/status/ID) plus WebSearch answer snippets (treated as unverified for exact dates and scope). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were probed via search. AusTender surfaced four verifiable Current-ATM link titles not present in the routine's 477 known dedup keys: RFT 02-2026 (Australian Federal Police — RFT, documents released via Deed-of-Confidentiality secure link, not on AusTender), ATM_2026_3512 (buyer not identifiable via search; October 2026 – October 2027 timeframe), and ATM_2026_2982 (buyer not identifiable; an older item shown as a Current ATM, reportedly last updated ~April 2026 — recorded but flagged as not-recent). NSW buy.nsw surfaced one verifiable link title, PD2025046-A, an Advance Notice for an upcoming Facilities Management Services tender (market-sounding). Other AusTender link titles returned by search were already-known dedup keys (EFA2026002, OPC-2026-02, OPC-2026-03, ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, ATM_2026_3858, OET-DRC-2026, PR10031930-RASS, JASD/RFT/20200/1, RFT-2026-0154, RFT-2026-0080, RFT/WLD/2026, RFT Tranches 1-4, RFI_ATM_2026_6026, ATM_2026_6786, ATM_2026_6066) or Closed (RFT-2026-0031). WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT returned only portal landing/search pages or aggregator results with no verifiable individual buyer link title; TAS items (Derby Master Plan, Reach Mowing, City Hall EOI) and NSW Destination NSW Vivid Sydney Site Management appeared only in answer prose and were NOT captured per the no-fabrication rule. Tier 2 (VendorPanel councils, universities, GBE utilities, CSIRO, public health) surfaced known sources only; university EOIs (USYD, UTS Connected Assessment, UOW ServiceNow) appeared only via aggregator (australiantenders) snippet prose without a buyer link title, and DFAT AusConnect RFT26-003 EOI had already closed (13-Sep-2026) — none captured. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Woolworths Partner Hub, Qantas): all corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. No genuinely NEW buyer-originated source surfaced this run; novel domains encountered (tenderhub.com.au, bidsfactory.com, australiatenders.com, consolidatedtenders.com, qld2032.com, australiantenders.com.au, tendersinfo.com) are third-party aggregators/scrapers, excluded per the buyer-originated rule (usable only as discovery signal).
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for ALL external hosts this run — confirmed against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all four captured tenders remain at headline level and require an authenticated/unblocked run for deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, exact dates, documents and contacts.

RFT 02-2026 (Australian Federal Police): full RFT documentation is deliberately not published on AusTender — access requires signing an AFP Deed of Confidentiality (AFP-RFT@afp.gov.au). Scope, deliverables, value and closing date could not be verified and are recorded null; access classified free-registration (gated).
ATM_2026_3512 (AusTender): buying agency not identifiable from search link title or snippet (detail page egress-blocked); buyer recorded as "" rather than guessed; closing date null.

ATM_2026_2982 (AusTender): buying agency not identifiable; item appears as a Current ATM but is reportedly an older listing (last updated ~April 2026), i.e. outside the 7-day recency window — captured for de-dup completeness only, all detail null, may warrant removal if a future unblocked run confirms it is closed.

PD2025046-A (buy.nsw): an Advance Notice / market-sounding for an upcoming Facilities Management Services tender (anticipated release Sept 2026, subject to change), not yet an open RFT; deliverables, exact release/closing dates and buyer detail unverifiable while egress-blocked.

State/territory portals (WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT): only landing/search pages or aggregator results returned; no verifiable individual buyer link title surfaced. TAS items (Derby Master Plan, Reach Mowing of Rural Roads, City Hall Activation EOI) and NSW Destination NSW Vivid Sydney Site Management appeared only in answer prose and were deferred, not captured.

Tier 2 (VendorPanel council tenders, universities/TAFEs, GBE utilities, CSIRO, public health): sampled via search only; university EOIs (USYD Campus Master Plan/Curriculum Management, UTS Connected Assessment Ecosystem closing 18-Sep-2026, UOW ServiceNow panels) surfaced only via aggregator snippet prose without a buyer link title and were not captured; DFAT AusConnect RFT26-003 EOI had already closed (13-Sep-2026). Full portal sweep deferred pending unblocked WebFetch.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Woolworths Partner Hub, Qantas): opportunity detail is registration-/invitation-gated and none publicly visible via search; portals recorded in discovered_sources only, no corporate tender fabricated.
No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run; novel domains encountered were aggregators/scrapers, excluded by policy.
